subject: Re: MuZero hardening — close-out plan and June staffing
body:
Ulla, Rafael,

Close-out plan for the 05-18 readout, plus staffing decisions for what comes next:

1. The distributed run starts Monday with the double-buffered batcher. The priority-reset bug is documented as a known issue rather than fixed this half — it self-corrects within an hour and doesn't change end scores measurably.
2. Post-readout, the follow-on hardening phase (priority-reset fix, preemption soak tests, and the Go/Chess-style board-game env users keep asking for) is staffed now so we don't lose momentum: Paloma Castillo is committed at 60% to MuZero for June 2026, with Rosa picking up her CI duties. Rafael stays advisory at 20%.
3. Rosa publishes the reference configs and Rafael's planning-knob guide alongside the readout.

Ulla — flagging item 2 for your headcount tracking; it's the whole June plan for this workstream.

Ivo
